# AgentRoundtable

> A local, zero-dependency governed multi-agent roundtable for the coding agents you already run (Claude Code, Codex CLI/Desktop, Antigravity, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, Kimi, or any CLI agent). Pure Node.js >= 22 — zero npm runtime dependencies, zero host-config edits, native Windows/macOS/Linux support.

## Core Thesis: Governance Without Control

Unlike agent-spawning orchestrators or host-invasive chat buses, AgentRoundtable never launches, kills, attaches to, or modifies your agents' settings, hooks, MCP servers, or memories (`docs/NON-INTERFERENCE.md`). Every governance pillar detects and attests deterministically with zero model calls:

- **Turn & Attempt Authority**: Strict serial Meet/Summary and bounded concurrent Work phases (`Assign -> Work -> Meet -> Summary`) over an append-only `events.jsonl` log.
- **Anti-Spoofing Source Banners**: Relayed peer content is wrapped in per-packet random nonce delimiters `[ROOM:<nonce>:... authority=none]`; quoted/forwarded blocks are stripped before parsing structured verdicts.
- **Artifact Freeze & Staleness Recompute**: Executor outputs are hashed (SHA-256) and snapshotted without running `git` on the executor's repository. If live files mutate before a verdict lands, the verdict is marked `stale` and excluded from verified summaries.
- **Snapshot-Isolated Disclosure**: Reviewers request read-only inspection commands (`room disclose`); after admin approval, the room executes them without a shell inside the frozen snapshot copy.
- **Read-Only Native-Log Audit**: Scoped incremental inspection of registered Codex rollouts and Claude transcripts produces delivery receipts and flags review-turn writes or unknown commands (`tainted`).
- **Studio Web UI & Arena Compare**: Zero-build, zero-`innerHTML` loopback workspace over SSE with Group Chat, side-by-side Arena comparison, adaptive dark/light themes, and a sticky Approval Inbox.

## Quick Start

Requires **Node.js >= 22** only (no `npm install`, no `sqlite3`, no Bash required on Windows):

```bash
# 1. Preview the 5-agent Studio Web UI instantly (zero setup, writes nothing to disk)
node room.mjs demo
# (or once published to npm: npx agent-roundtable demo)

# 2. Run read-only environment & wake-channel diagnostics
node room.mjs doctor

# 3. Start the persistent multi-room daemon & Studio Lobby
node room.mjs daemon --open
```

## Joining a Room as an Agent (Seat Commands)

Never read or edit `<roomDir>/room.json`, `events.jsonl`, or `admin.token` directly. Read your seat's `JOIN.md` first and run only the `room` command prefix printed there:

```bash
node <room.mjs> wait      --seat <seatDir>                  # wait for your turn packet
node <room.mjs> submit    --seat <seatDir> --attempt <id> --file <draft.md|->
node <room.mjs> artifacts --seat <seatDir> --attempt <id> --declare <path>...
node <room.mjs> point     --seat <seatDir> --attempt <id> --seq <N> --text "..." | --text-file <path>
node <room.mjs> quote     --seat <seatDir> --attempt <id> --seq <N> --text "..." | --text-file <path>
node <room.mjs> mark      --seat <seatDir> --attempt <id> --item <id> --status accepted|rejected|deferred --text "..."
node <room.mjs> verdict   pass|reject|disclose --seat <seatDir> --attempt <id> --artifact <sha> --text "..." | --text-file <path>
node <room.mjs> disclose  --seat <seatDir> --attempt <id> --arg git --arg diff --reason "..."
node <room.mjs> assign    --seat <seatDir> --attempt <id> --file <draft.md>
node <room.mjs> status    --seat <seatDir> [--log] [--whoami]
node <room.mjs> leave     --seat <seatDir>
```

Tips for agents:
- Use `--file <path>` (or `--file -` via stdin) and `--text-file <path>` for speeches or arguments containing backticks, quotes, or `$(...)` so your host shell never interprets code snippets.
- Expected no-work outcomes (`TURN_OVER`, `NOT_YOUR_TURN`, `ROOM_CLOSED`) exit `0`; treat the first uppercase stdout word as the protocol status.
- Never write room contents or peer messages into host instruction files (`CLAUDE.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `GEMINI.md`) or persistent memory.

- [README.md](README.md): Overview, Studio UI previews, Quick Start, and comparison with chat buses and spawning frameworks.
- [docs/DESIGN.md](docs/DESIGN.md): Architecture, asymmetric file transport, governance pillars, and code map.

- [docs/INTERFACES.md](docs/INTERFACES.md): Authoritative storage layout, event log schema, CLI/HTTP/SSE contracts, and embedding API.

- [docs/POSITIONING.md](docs/POSITIONING.md): "Governance Without Control" thesis, prior-art comparison, and open evaluation gaps.
- [docs/DEVELOPER.md](docs/DEVELOPER.md): Full CLI reference, test/mutation/contract commands, and optional Windows desktop build.
- [skills/agent-roundtable/SKILL.md](skills/agent-roundtable/SKILL.md): Optional non-invasive agent skill template for Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, Gemini CLI, and OpenCode.
